sections.name: goal
sections.value: A prime plans, starts, takes down and brings back a group of seats as one pod.

value.title: The pod template and pod folders
value.done_when: A pod template validates from a path in the main repo or in governance, with slots, consulted roles, deliverables, tools and a model a slot must not share; pod folders under `community/pods/` are written only by pij; memory is filed per role and subject, and `--fresh` leaves earlier memory out.

value.title: Plan, up and show, with warnings
value.done_when: `plan` writes nothing and names every warning with its fix; `up` starts each slot through `spawn --as`, canaries each slot's tools, warns and still starts, logs each warning, and creates no branch or worktree; the spawn counter moves by one spawn per slot.

value.title: Set, down, revive and reshape
value.done_when: `set` reaches only the members that need a value; `down` runs `close --stop` per member, spares keep-open members with a warning, records the work branch's head and warns when the run is unfrozen; a closed pod comes back under revive's rules; a running pod is reshaped and logged.

value.title: Session history
value.done_when: `pij sessions --history` and `pij pod sessions` list every session a seat used, with why it changed, read from the event log with no new storage; a past session's context size is read from a capped transcript tail or shown as unknown; nothing is launched.

value.title: Pod activity view
value.done_when: `pij pod activity <pod>` shows any seat the pod's state changes, outputs, sends and transcript locations, read only, with no role or membership test.

value.title: Deliverables: owners, stages and write-back
value.done_when: Each deliverable shows its owner role and stages; a first stage is recorded while a member is late; a recorded stage is written back to the role the template names as one request, which outlives the pod.

value.change: Owner moves from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001, which runs the build of PRDs 006, 007, 008 and 010 (operator's approval, 2026-11-25).
